text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Since you paid with buy-now-pay-later, your refund won't go to your card or to Leafy store credit by default. It goes to the **instalment provider**, who will then adjust your remaining payments to reflect the refund.

A couple of things that may help:

- **Refund timing:** Leafy issues your refund within **5 business days** of the returned pot reaching our warehouse.
- **Your payments:** The instalment provider handles the adjustment to your remaining payments. I don't have details on exactly how or when it shows up in your instalment plan, so their app or account is the best place to check.
- **Return label:** If you haven't dropped off the parcel yet, remember the prepaid label expires after **7 days**.
- **Change-of-mind returns:** These cost a flat **$6.95**, which is deducted from the refund (free for Leafy Plus members). Faulty or incorrect items return free.

If anything looks off once the refund has been issued, just reach out and we'll be happy to help. Chat is open 8am-8pm Mon-Sat, or you can email help@leafy.example (we reply within 1 business day).

Is there anything else I can help you with? Happy planting! 🪴
